title: Crunchy Keto Bites
description: A crispy, crunchy, and delicious keto snack made with just a few ingredients. Perfect for munching on the go!
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the crunchy, pepper, and crispy.
Divide the mixture into 12 equal parts and shape each part into a small ball.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
